Only the board (including the Cloud envelope actor, which is a board actor) may apply an onboarding seed; an agent could otherwise create a ceo agent, a goal, a project and a root task. assertBoard is added to the existing authz import.

Agents in Crew companies cannot create, update, archive or delete projects or project workspaces (403 crew_board_only); the MCP create_project tool calls the same REST route with the agent token, so it is refused too. Workspace runtime controls stay stock.
Agents in Crew companies cannot hard-delete issues, even their own (403 crew_board_only); the delete path bypasses the issue write hook.

An agent in a Crew company checks out only issues that are unassigned or already assigned to itself (409 crew_checkout_forbidden): it cannot take an issue assigned to another agent or waiting on a user such as the owner. Board checkout on behalf of an agent stays stock.

Agents in Crew companies cannot update execution workspaces (403 crew_board_only). Board only, because core has no per-agent workspace owner (runtime:manage is company-wide) and Crew agents run in place from their environment.

Deliver plugin events to the worker as a call (deliverEventAsCall, same 15-minute ceiling) instead of a notification, so the event's invocation scope is cleared when the handlers settle; a lingering scope made every unscoped worker-to-host call fail with INVOCATION_SCOPE_DENIED for 15 minutes after each event. Other notifications are unchanged. Upstream text: plans/261010-0020-crew-v3-r3/reports/upstream-plugin-event-scope.md in the Crew repo.
